prompt: For each price rise that took effect from 1 to 31 January 2025, the plan needs the average weekly units in the 8 weeks before its change week (the week, Monday to Sunday, that holds valid_from), the change week itself left out and a week with no sale counting as 0. Which query gives it, one row per rise?

options.text:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), rises AS (
  -- one row per price rise from 1 to 31 January 2025, with the Monday of its week
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur > prev_price AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-01-31'
)
SELECT r.product_id, r.valid_from, SUM(w.units) / 8.0 AS avg_units_before
FROM rises r
JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND r.change_week - INTERVAL 7 DAY
GROUP BY r.product_id, r.valid_from

SELECT r.product_id, r.valid_from, AVG(w.units) AS avg_units_before
FROM rises r
JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND r.change_week - INTERVAL 7 DAY
  AND w.units > 0
GROUP BY r.product_id, r.valid_from
